title: Telepathy Tapes: nonverbal autistic children who know Egyptian hieroglyphics

tellings.quote: they come out like they know certain Egyptian hieroglyphics and stuff

plain: Some autistic children who cannot speak seem to know things nobody taught them: in Michels' words, "they come out like they know certain Egyptian hieroglyphics and stuff." Michels mentions this in passing, drawing on The Telepathy Tapes, a project he connects with Ky Dickens. If it were true, it would suggest these children reach knowledge by some route other than ordinary learning.
